    To StartMainsSomething SweetTo Drink
    To StartOwen's cabin campfire sausagesBeef sausages with jammy onions and mustard. "You silly sausage!"How to make it2 brown onions, sliced1 tbsp brown sugar8 thick beef sausages2 tbsp wholegrain mustard1 tbsp oilCook the onions slowly in the oil with the sugar until jammy.Grill the sausages over coals until blistered and cooked through.Slice thickly, spear on toothpicks and serve with the onions and mustard.Dino egg scotch eggsEggs in sausage meat and breadcrumbs. Life finds a way.How to make it7 eggs500g sausage meat1/2 cup plain flour1 egg, beaten1 cup breadcrumbs1 L vegetable oil, for deep fryingBoil six of the eggs for 6 minutes, cool and peel.Wrap each egg in sausage meat, then roll in flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs.Deep fry in the vegetable oil at 170°C for 6 minutes, or bake at 200°C for 25 minutes, until golden and cooked through.Halve to serve.Lockwood auction smoked salmon on ryeSold at the Lockwood auction. Cured fish on rye, lemon crème fraîcheHow to make itNot on tonight's cookToasted rye squares topped with lemon crème fraîche, folds of smoked salmon, capers and dill, passed round on trays like at the auction.Cut 6 slices dark rye into quarters, brush with olive oil and toast at 180°C for 8 minutes until crisp, then cool.Mix 150g crème fraîche with the zest of 1 lemon and a pinch of salt.Spread a little on each square, top with a fold of smoked salmon from 200g, 2 capers and a dill sprig.Finish with cracked pepper and serve within the hour.MainsIsla Nublar stampede chilli lime chicken and beansStampede special. Chilli lime thighs, rice and beansHow to make it1kg chicken thigh fillets3 limes, 2 for the marinade and 1 for the salsa3 garlic cloves, crushed1 red chilli, chopped2 tbsp oil1 tsp salt300g long grain rice800g black beans, drained1 tsp ground cumin1 tsp smoked paprika3 tomatoes, diced1/2 red onion, diced2 tbsp chopped corianderMarinate the chicken in lime juice, garlic, chilli, oil and salt for an hour.Grill over high heat until charred and cooked through. Cook the rice at the same time.Warm the beans with the cumin and paprika.Mix the tomatoes, onion, coriander and a squeeze of lime for the salsa. Serve the chicken over rice and beans with the salsa.Lockwood Manor eye fillet with red wine jusSeared hard and roasted pink, glossy reduction, potato gratin and beans, for Maisie upstairsHow to make itNot on tonight's cookBeef eye fillet seared hard and roasted pink, sliced with a glossy red wine jus, creamy potato gratin and buttered green beans.Layer 1kg thinly sliced potatoes in a buttered dish with 300ml cream, 2 garlic cloves and salt, and bake at 180°C for 1 hour.Season a 1kg eye fillet, sear all over in a hot pan and roast at 200°C for 20 minutes for medium-rare, then rest 10 minutes.In the same pan, boil 250ml red wine and 250ml beef stock until reduced by half, then whisk in 30g butter.Blanch 300g green beans for 3 minutes.Something SweetOwen's campfire banana boatsBananas stuffed with chocolate and marshmallows, foil-wrapped and cooked on the barbecueHow to make it4 bananas100g dark chocolate, chopped50g mini marshmallows4 digestive biscuits, crushedSlit the bananas lengthways through the top skin without cutting through the bottom and open slightly.Stuff with chocolate and marshmallows. Wrap each in foil.Cook on a barbecue or at 200°C in the oven until melted.Open the foil, scatter with crushed biscuits and eat with spoons.To DrinkBlue's butterfly pea lime fizzButterfly pea tea, honey, lemonade and lime. "Blue is alive."How to make it2 tbsp dried butterfly pea flowers500ml boiling water3 tbsp honey1.3 L lemonade2 limes, cut into wedges1 bag crushed iceSteep the butterfly pea flowers in the boiling water for 10 minutes. Strain, stir in the honey and chill.Fill four glasses with crushed ice and pour in the blue tea until half full.Top each with lemonade. Serve with lime wedges and let everyone squeeze in the lime to watch the colour change.Earl Grey iced teaIris raised Maisie. This tea is for her.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
